title: Question 25
passage:
How did the parcel end up at our old office?
A. The return label still had that address on it. B. It’s three blocks from the new office. C. I opened it after lunch.
passageZh:
這個包裹怎麼送到我們舊辦公室了？
A. 退貨標籤上還印著舊辦公室地址。 B. 它離新辦公室三個街區。 C. 我是午飯後拆開它的。
